title: Context manipulation attacks : Web agents are susceptible to corrupted memory
authors: Atharv Singh Patlan; Ashwin Hebbar; Pramod Viswanath; Prateek Mittal
why_relevant: Studies context/memory manipulation attacks on web agents, related to indirect prompt injection and memory poisoning. Tangentially relevant to RAG adversarial corruption but focused on agent memory rather than retrieval.
why_not_or_caveat: Targets web navigation agents' planner memory, not retrieval-augmented generation per se.
